'''Mi'zhi''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] in {{location|Tiger's Maw Mine}}. He first appears in the [[Side Quest]] {{Quest|The Fabled Magnetic Cube Mechanics - I}}. He is an engineer<ref>[[Side Quest]] {{Quest|The Fabled Magnetic Cube Mechanics - I}}</ref> and [[Qingshu]]'s junior.<ref>[[Side Quest]] {{Quest|The Fabled Magnetic Cube Mechanics - II}}</ref>
